  • Enum-Konstanten - Übersicht

    Enum-Konstanten
    Enum-Konstante
    Beschreibung
    FIXED_HORIZON
    Use the same scrollbar that is being used for the standard JavaFX controls such as ListView, TableView, or TreeView.
    INFINITE
    Use a specialized scrollbar for infinite scrolling into the future and into the past.
    NONE
    Do not display a scrollbar at all.

      public static final GanttChartBase.ScrollBarType NONE
      Do not display a scrollbar at all.

    • FIXED_HORIZON

      public static final GanttChartBase.ScrollBarType FIXED_HORIZON
      Use the same scrollbar that is being used for the standard JavaFX controls such as ListView, TableView, or TreeView. The bounds of the scrollbar will be defined by the horizon start and end times defined inside the timeline model.
